environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS. The container runs as root with full network egress. libxmljs2 v0.33.0 installed. PostgreSQL has RLS policies on the invoices table but the application connects using a superuser role (postgres) which bypasses RLS. No XML preprocessing or input validation middleware. Container has access to instance metadata endpoint and internal network resources.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON invoices USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.rls_note: RLS is defined but superuser role bypasses it
